The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court is a court of general jurisdiction that handles a wide range of legal matters. It is one of 24 circuit courts in Maryland and is located in Annapolis. The court has six judges and various support staff, including clerks, bailiffs, and court reporters.

History of the Anne Arundel County Circuit Court

The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court has a long and rich history dating back to the 17th century when the county was established. The court was initially held in various locations, including the State House, before the current courthouse was built in 1824. The courthouse has undergone several renovations over the years and now houses the circuit court, district court, and other county offices.

Jurisdiction of the Circuit Court

The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court has jurisdiction over a wide range of cases, including criminal, civil, family law, and probate cases. It also hears appeals from lower courts and administrative agencies.

Types of Cases Handled by the Circuit Court

The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court handles various types of cases, including:

Criminal Cases in the Circuit Court

The circuit court has jurisdiction over serious criminal cases, including felonies, misdemeanors, and traffic offenses. It also handles juvenile delinquency cases and mental health cases.

Civil Cases in the Circuit Court

The circuit court handles civil cases involving disputes between individuals or organizations. Examples of civil cases include contract disputes, personal injury lawsuits, and property disputes.

Family Law Cases in the Circuit Court

The circuit court handles family law cases, including divorce, child custody, child support, and adoption cases.

Probate Cases in the Circuit Court

The circuit court handles probate cases, including wills, estates, and trusts.

Appeals in the Circuit Court

The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court hears appeals from lower courts and administrative agencies. Appeals can be filed by individuals or organizations who believe they were wrongly convicted or have a dispute with a lower court's decision.

Court Administration and Services

The Anne Arundel County Circuit Court provides various court administration and services, including:

  • Clerk's office: The clerk's office maintains court records, processes court filings, and provides assistance to the public.
  • Jury services: The court coordinates and manages jury duty for residents of Anne Arundel County.
  • Court security: The court has a security team that provides security
  • for the courthouse and ensures the safety of judges, staff, and visitors.
  • Interpreter services: The court provides interpreter services for individuals who require assistance with language translation during court proceedings.
